Full-time traveler review
While visiting Bangkok, I broke a tooth which required medical attention. The Thaniya clinic was listed as a trusted service by one of my travel committees.

Appointment was scheduled on WhatsApp for the next day. Upon arrival I found the office to be clean, modern and the staff very nice. It’s a small private office and very professional.

The Dentist is awesome! He spoke English and was thorough in his consultation & treatment.

The final bill was less than $200 USD with no insurance.

Services: consultation, xray, tooth pulled, collagen placed in gum, stitches, pain meds & antibiotics.

I was very pleased with the entire experience and happy to say I now have a dentist in Bangkok. 👍🏾
